title: Vintage Le Creuset Fondue Set – Complete – Cast Iron – Original Box
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset fondue set, complete and presented in its original box. A rare and charming piece, perfect for convivial dinners and collectors alike.
✔️ Made in France – authentic Le Creuset craftsmanship
✔️ Complete set including:
Enameled cast iron fondue pot
Metal stand
Burner (fuel holder)
6 original fondue forks with wooden handles
Original booklet/manual
✔️ Original box included (with visible signs of age)
✔️ Condition: very good
Pot interior clean and well preserved
Light, normal signs of use on burner and stand
Box shows wear consistent with age
